- Go to Settings > General > Software Update to check for iOS updates.

- In the Mail app, look for an “Outbox” folder. If emails are stuck, try resending or deleting them.

- Go to Settings > Mail > Accounts.
- Select your email account, turn Mail off, wait a few seconds, then turn it back on.
